Judge the light from the chair

By v/hNovember 25, 2026Visual note

Originally shared
on LinkedIn

View the post ↗← All journal entries

A lamp can light the page and still be uncomfortable to sit beside.

For the v/h lamp, we want to judge the light from the chair. The useful view is the one someone has while reading, leaning back or reaching for the switch.

Our proposed check would look for a bright source directly in the reader's line of sight, a hand casting a shadow across the page, and a control that takes an awkward reach. We would repeat it with the lamp on either side and at different brightness settings.

The shade, light source and controls should make the lamp useful before it has learned any routine. Local assistance then has to reduce the effort of using the lamp.

No physical prototype has been built yet. We still need to build and validate the light and controls described here.
